notes: Level is the frozen training-only signed degradation-axis projection with causal smoothing.
Trend is the causal least-squares slope of the last ten Level outputs.
Movement is current standardized embedding surprise relative to the ensemble forecast made from the preceding prefix, divided by the training-bearing median surprise.
All residual checkpoints and the signed axis are frozen; no model is retrained.
The three outputs are relative signals, not absolute damage, RUL or physical health percentages.
All bearings have been inspected previously; metrics are descriptive integration diagnostics.
